changelog:
Initial release of send-file skill for reliable Telegram file delivery:

- Converts workspace files (especially Markdown) to downloadable PDF or ZIP for Telegram.
- Handles Telegram delivery issues: ensures Markdown and text files are always received as documents, not as inline text.
- Provides Bash tooling for PDF conversion (`mdpdf`) and archiving (`zip`).
- Includes clear usage instructions and delivery patterns for single and multiple files.
- Supports original media types (PDF, images) for direct delivery without conversion.
- Details requirements and special filename suffixes for reliable Telegram download.
